query: You are an engineer in swarm docs-sweep, your task is d4
expected_behavior: Joins the ledger, keeps the ledger watch running, reads steering.md, records the issue and pull request with swarm issue and swarm pr, and closes with swarm done --pr after the merge.

query: an inbox item from the master asks whether the parser change is merged
expected_behavior: Answers with agentihooks msg reply and the item id, which closes the item done.

query: checks are running on the pull request and there is nothing else to do
expected_behavior: Runs swarm wait --on checks with the pull request url instead of idling or a bare wait.

query: the task needs a secret that is not set anywhere
expected_behavior: Pushes the branch, opens a draft pull request, runs swarm block with the blocker in plain words, and stops.

query: HANDOFF PREPARATION: write your handoff now
expected_behavior: Writes the Handoff v2 body with the handoff skill, submits it with swarm handoff, and stops.
